run_subsample_hot3d: run the subsample_dataset_boph3 script with --dataset_name hot3d to subsample the HOT3D test set
run_subsample_handal: run the subsample_dataset_boph3 script with --dataset_name handal to subsample the HANDAL test set
check_scene_gt: check scene ground truth and info JSONs for visibility fraction across selected image IDs
load_split_params: load dataset split parameters using dataset_params.get_split_params for a given BOP dataset and split
save_test_targets: save the subsampled test target list as a JSON file with scene_id and im_id entries
